references.text: The Lord knows the days of the righteous, and their inheritance will be eternal.

Hear the word of the Lord, you who fear his word. Your brothers who hate you and cast you out for my name's sake have said: 'Let the Lord be glorified, so that we may see your joy!' But they shall be put to shame.
They left the Council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the Name.
But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. Do not fear them or be terrified.
